text:
Alex H: Quick heads-up — hotfix PR #8421 addresses a kv-cache OOM seen in prod. Cutoff for this window is 21:30 UTC (~1h from now). We need 2x LGTM before the merge gate. PR: https://github.com/redwood/pr/8421
Priya S: pinging @Jordan K and @Sam R for second eyes. CI is green except one flaky e2e (looks unrelated). :eyes:
Jordan K: on my calendar, I can review in ~12m. Can someone paste the migration snippet?
Sam R: looking now — initial skim: main change is the cache eviction tweak and a small perf regression test. I want to confirm no schema changes.
Alex H: no schema changes, migration is a short KV cleanup (idempotent). snippet in PR description:```bash
# safe cleanup (idempotent)
redwood-migrate --env=prod --dry-run --filter=kv_cleanup
```
Jordan K: thanks. local run looks safe. small nit on a logging message, will leave comment.
Priya S: CI -> green on lint/unit. failing e2e is `test/serving/e2e/timeout_spec` — likely infra flake. Bucketing as non-blocking unless Sam flags something else.
Sam R: I left two small comments about a concurrency edge (race when cache flush overlaps request). Suggest adding a short sleep in test and a note in release notes.
Alex H: added test tweak and a short note under "behavioral changes" in PR. Updated commit with fix (pushed).
Jordan K: LGTM (left comment thread acknowledged).
Sam R: LGTM as well after the small test tweak. :+1:
Devin (release-bot): Merge window opens in 15m. Automerge disabled for this hotfix; requires manual confirmation after 2x LGTM.
Alex H: Great — we have 2x LGTM. @Devin (release-bot) can you hold open the merge gate until smoke is run?
Devin (release-bot): Acknowledged. Manual merge pending smoke check. Run smoke: `./scripts/smoke-check.sh --targets=kv-cache`
Priya S: smoke ran on staging — looks clean. Verified recent repro no longer triggers OOM during 30m soak.
Alex H: merging now, will monitor traces and SLO dashboards for 30m. If anything spikes we will roll back.
Jordan K: copying rollback plan here: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/serving --to-revision=stable-2026-03-18-1`
Sam R: monitoring dashboards now, will ping in #eng-sre if anything unusual.
Alex H: merged. Big thanks to everyone for quick eyes. :tada:
Devin (release-bot): Release note: hotfix/kv-cache-8421 merged by Alex H at 21:18 UTC. Post-deploy checks scheduled at T+5m, T+15m, T+30m.
